d:
The Supreme Court, on Thursday (November 5, 2026), observed that the High Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC) looking into police brutality during the July 20 protests reported that “very few complaints” were received. The Action Taken Report issued on October 31 noted that none were received physically or online.
The Court allowed petitioners the liberty to forward whatever material they have, including video clips, to the HPEC for its consideration.
Thank you for watching our video!
